title: Legal notice for a cheque returned unpaid
description: A demand notice for a cheque the bank returned unpaid. The statute, the time limits and the wording of consequences are left for a lawyer: this template states none of them.

fields.label: Name of the person or business that received the cheque
Name of the person or business that issued the cheque
What the cheque was given for
fields.help: State the facts neutrally: the goods, services or loan, and the dates

fields.label: Bank and branch the cheque is drawn on
Date the cheque was presented to the bank
Date the bank returned it (see the bank's return memo)
Reason the bank gave in its return memo
Days you allow for payment
fields.help: A lawyer must confirm the period that applies

lawyer_checks: Which statutory provision applies and the exact time limits for sending the notice and for payment
Whether the cheque and return memo meet the conditions for this kind of notice
Whether the facts as written are accurate and neutral
Mode of delivery and keeping proof of it
Whether the notice should come from an advocate
